summary: Penske Automotive Group filed an 8-K disclosing an Oct 15, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger with Motown Acquisition Corp., an entity owned by Penske Corporation and Mitsui. The buyer will merge into the company, which survives as a subsidiary of the Investor Group. A special committee of independent directors unanimously recommended the deal, and the board approved it with affiliated directors recused. Moelis delivered a fairness opinion. No price per share, premium, or close date was provided in the excerpt. Watch for proxy filing details, dissent levels, financing, and regulatory approvals.
